title: FBI Photo B024
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: grayscale surveillance/targeting video still with overlay graphics
pages.description: A noisy, grainy grayscale frame resembling a targeting or sensor camera view. A white crosshair reticle is centered, formed by a vertical line and a horizontal line, with small '3' tick labels near each end of the horizontal line. A small dark blob sits at the center of the crosshair. Several black rectangular bars (redaction-like blocks) are arranged in two columns on the left and right sides, some partly overlapped by lighter gray patches. A wide black bar spans the top of the image. In the lower-left corner, white text shows a date and time stamp.
